title: 993 Turbo cooling-fan drive speed, fan pressure rise and fan-outlet air temperature during stationary quasi-steady holds

twin_reference.use: Axis convention of the fan frame only. No geometry, clearance, flow or integration result of that archived F0 record is consumed, and the record's status is not changed by this contract.

specimen.description: One cooling-fan assembly (impeller, fan housing and belt drive) installed on one 993 Turbo M64/60 engine. In this revision the specimen is a synthetic placeholder: no physical specimen exists behind this identifier.
specimen.identity_status: Not established. The Turbo impeller reconstruction target 96410601522 (twins/993-engine-cooling-fan-system-f0/README.md) is a research hypothesis; a real specimen must be bound by an outside contributor under an anonymous identifier whose mapping stays private.

scope.use_case: Predict fan shaft speed, fan static pressure rise and fan-outlet air temperature from crankshaft speed, fan-inlet air temperature and ambient pressure, and compare each prediction with its observed channel during declared steady holds with the vehicle stationary.
included: Belt-driven fan speed relative to crankshaft speed
Fan static pressure rise between the inlet and outlet stations of the fan housing
Air temperature rise across the fan from fan work, between the inlet and outlet stations
excluded: Cylinder, cylinder-head, oil or intercooler temperatures and heat rejection
Cooling-air distribution between cylinders and leakage paths
Transient behaviour, belt dynamics, thermal lag of probes and road-speed ram effects
Structural, fatigue or clearance behaviour of the impeller

frames.origin: Centre of the impeller front face on the rotation axis (F0 assumption shared with TWIN-993-ENGINE-COOLING-FAN-SYSTEM-F0).
frames.axes: X and Y in the plane of rotation; Z along the fan axis toward the rear of the engine; positive angular velocity is right-handed about +Z.
frames.status: Assumed. The transform to the engine frame of M64-WHOLE-ENGINE-TWIN-0001 is unknown and is not used.

stations.description: Inlet air upstream of the impeller front face.
stations.status: Assumed region for a synthetic instrumentation plan; not measured.

stations.description: Fan-housing outlet volume downstream of the impeller and upstream of any cylinder or cooler.
stations.status: Assumed region for a synthetic instrumentation plan; not measured.

stations.description: Angular-velocity sensing about the fan axis; the sensing axis must be parallel or antiparallel to +Z.
stations.status: Alignment requirement only; no position requirement.

quantities.note: Signed about +Z of F_FAN for N_FAN; magnitude for N_CRANK.
Absolute temperature. Uncertainties convert with the scale factor only, never the offset.
Outlet minus inlet static pressure; never mixed with absolute pressure.

channels.sign_convention: Magnitude of crankshaft angular velocity; no frame projection.
Scalar; barometric pressure near the fan inlet.
Signed angular velocity about the sensor sensing axis, converted to +Z of F_FAN by the sign of the sensing-axis cosine with +Z, whose magnitude must reach the station min_abs_axis_cosine.
Outlet tap minus inlet tap; the station is that of the outlet tap.

timebase_requirements.sample_time_reference: Every sample time and arrival time is in seconds since the observation set's epoch, on the one acquisition clock named by its timebase_id. Wall-clock time of the replay host is never read.

operating_envelope.source: Synthetic declaration for this software contract. These are not Porsche operating limits and must be replaced by sourced limits before any real specimen is admitted.

operating_cases.description: Engine at operating temperature, vehicle stationary, no road load, crankshaft speed held at declared levels.
operating_cases.vehicle_state: Stationary; no ram air; engine cover and cooling ducts as fitted on the specimen.

residual_rules.residual_definition: r = observed - predicted, both in the canonical unit and, for N_FAN, expressed about +Z of F_FAN.
residual_rules.uncertainty_definition: u_r = sqrt(u_predicted^2 + u_observed^2), standard uncertainties (k = 1). u_predicted propagates input and parameter uncertainties to first order; z = r / u_r.
residual_rules.systematic_note: Parameter uncertainty is shared by every frame, so frame verdicts are correlated and their counts are not independent trials.

sample_rules.sample_tuple: [sequence, sample_time_s, arrival_time_s, value_or_null, flag]; value in the channel unit; flag one of ok, missing, source_outlier, sensor_fault; value is null exactly when the flag is missing.
sample_rules.selection: For each evaluation time t, each channel contributes its latest received sample with sample_time_s <= t + max_inter_channel_skew_s. Late samples are invisible. A selected sample older than the channel max_age_s is stale. A selected sample that is flagged, out of instrument or plausible range, or outside its calibration validity yields no claim; the replay never falls back to an older sample.

no_claim_states.meaning: No sample selected, or the selected sample is flagged missing.
The selected sample is older than the channel max_age_s.
The sample arrived after the latency budget and was excluded; reported in ingest counts.
The source flagged the selected sample as a sensor fault.
The source flagged the selected sample as an outlier.
The selected value is outside the instrument range or the channel plausible range.
The sample time falls outside the calibration validity window.
A usable input lies outside the declared operating envelope.
The evaluation time lies outside every declared steady window.
Inside a declared window, the steady reference channel departs from the window median by more than steady_tolerance_rel.
An output cannot be predicted because an input it depends on has no claim.

offline_replay.definition: After acquisition, one immutable, hashed observation set is replayed at fixed evaluation times. The result depends only on the bound inputs and the implementation revision, never on replay wall-clock time, host or order of files on disk.

live_synchronisation.definition: Continuous update of the twin state from an acquisition stream while the specimen operates, with bounded end-to-end latency.
blockers: No real specimen, acquisition system or lawful observation stream exists for this repository.
No transport, buffering, clock-discipline or latency-budget design has been specified or measured.
Offline replay results do not establish live cadence, latency or availability.

privacy.specimen_identifier_policy: Only the anonymous specimen_id enters Git. Any mapping from it to a vehicle, engine or owner is held privately by the contributor and never committed.
privacy.raw_data_policy: Measured samples stay in the private evidence release. Git may hold their canonical sha256 and sample counts (samples_ref), and derived results only where the source rights allow it. Inline samples are admitted only for data_class synthetic.
forbidden_content: Vehicle identification numbers, chassis, engine or gearbox serial numbers
Owner, workshop or contributor personal data

claim_limits.fixture_statement: The committed observation set is synthetic, generated from this model family with injected noise, faults and a deliberate drive-slip discrepancy. Agreement or disagreement with it demonstrates software behaviour only and is never evidence about a Porsche 993.

open_blockers.needed: A lawful observation set from an instrumented 993 Turbo, contributed by an outside party under recorded consent and rights (the charter excludes in-house measurement).
open_blockers.unlocks: Any comparison with a physical specimen.

open_blockers.needed: Documented identity of the fitted impeller, fan housing and pulleys on that specimen, held privately behind the anonymous specimen_id.
open_blockers.unlocks: Binding observations to one physical specimen.

open_blockers.needed: Sourced pulley diameters or drive ratio and belt slip (acquisition contract M64-ACQ-0005).
open_blockers.unlocks: Replacing the synthetic i_drive and s_belt parameters.

open_blockers.needed: A sourced fan pressure-rise characteristic and efficiency at a stated reference speed, with uncertainty.
open_blockers.unlocks: Replacing the synthetic dp_ref and eta_fan parameters.

open_blockers.needed: Traceable calibration certificates for every instrument, hashed in a private register, with validity windows covering the session.
open_blockers.unlocks: Non-synthetic uncertainties and calibration validity checks.

open_blockers.needed: Measured sensor positions and orientations in F_FAN, and the F_FAN to engine-frame transform.
open_blockers.unlocks: Station checks against a real instrumentation plan.

open_blockers.needed: A measured inter-channel skew and drift for the acquisition clock.
Independent human engineering review of this contract, the residual thresholds and the operating envelope.
open_blockers.unlocks: Accepting the contract for real observations.

open_blockers.needed: Design and measurement of a live acquisition, transport and latency path.
